answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings before its Wesolowski proof can be accepted. The dependency between squarings prevents a GPU from shortening an individual chain through parallel computation; GPUs can run separate clone chains concurrently, but each clone still incurs the full physical delay. A trellis of identities therefore demands proportionate work, not merely an umber of cheap labels scattered across a reef of accounts.
